description: Server-side events posted to batch.datax.yahoo.com/v1/events/{pixelId}. The pixel ID rides in the path. Dot image pixels stay vendor/yahoo-dot. Product CAPI, which requires eventId, is not contracted.

params.name: pixel_id
params.description: It is the Yahoo DSP pixel ID. Yahoo documents the batch endpoint as /v1/events/{pixelId}.
params.fix_hint: Put the DSP pixel ID in the path, such as /v1/events/10157549. Do not reuse a live Dot pixel ID.

params.name: eventTs
params.description: It is the event time in seconds or milliseconds. Yahoo documents eventTs as required.
params.fix_hint: Set eventTs to a Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds.

params.name: eventName
params.description: It is the event action name. Yahoo documents eventName as required.
params.fix_hint: Set eventName to the action the DSP rule matches, such as addToCart or Purchase.

params.name: actionSource
params.description: It is the digital or physical source of the event. Yahoo documents actionSource as required.
params.fix_hint: Set actionSource to a source such as web, app, phone, email, online, or physical_store.

params.name: userData
params.description: It is the wrapper for match keys. Yahoo documents userData as required, with at least one ID or clickData.
params.fix_hint: Send a userData object with hashed email, phone, device ID, or pxid, or send clickData.

params.name: userData.email
params.description: Email must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed. Yahoo documents userData.email as a list of hashes.
params.fix_hint: Lowercase the email, hash it with SHA-256, and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: userData.email[]
params.description: Every email in the list must be SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Lowercase each email, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digests.

params.name: userData.phone
params.description: Phone numbers must be SHA-256 hashed. Yahoo documents userData.phone as a list of hashes.
params.fix_hint: Hash the phone number with SHA-256 and send 64 lowercase hex characters.

params.name: userData.phone[]
params.description: Every phone number in the list must be SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Hash each phone number with SHA-256 and send the hex digests.

params.name: userData.gpsaid
params.description: It is a list of Android advertising IDs.

params.name: userData.idfa
params.description: It is a list of Apple advertising IDs.

params.name: userData.pxid
params.description: It is a list of partner match IDs in the form sourceId:value.

params.name: clickData.vmcid
params.description: It is the Yahoo Click ID. Yahoo documents clickData as a match key when user IDs are not available.

params.name: clickData.tblci
params.description: It is the Taboola Click ID.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. Yahoo documents userData.email as SHA-256 hashed, lowercased values.
rules.fix_hint: Lowercase the email, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest in userData.email.

rules.message: The event has no match key. Yahoo documents at least one of hashed email, phone, gpsaid, idfa, pxid, or clickData.
rules.fix_hint: Send hashed userData.email, phone, gpsaid, idfa, or pxid, or send clickData.vmcid or clickData.tblci.
